items.description: Trending on Hacker News from convo.casa. 103 points and 103 comments.

items.title: yc-software/minecraft-agent-harness
items.description: Run language-model agents in Minecraft with Mineflayer tools, persistent sessions and shell sandboxes.
items.ai_summary: Minecraft-agent-harness is a tool for running language-model agents in Minecraft using Mineflayer tools, persistent sessions, and shell sandboxes.

items.title: FDSML: Formula-Driven Supervised Metric Learning with Parameter-Aware Triplet Loss
items.description: Formula-driven supervised metric learning uses continuous generative parameters to train embeddings with parameter-aware triplet loss, improving synthetic pre-training for image retrieval and robustness.

items.title: Youtu-Parsing-Omni: One Encoder, One Schema, All Modalities
items.description: Youtu-Parsing-Omni is a unified multi-modal parser that encodes documents, images, audio, and video into structured spatiotemporal records using shared weights and cross-modal fusion, achieving state-of-the-art results across parsing benchmarks through a self-evolving on-policy…

items.title: OpenFlyV2: An onboard vision-language-action model for aerial perception and navigation
items.description: OpenFlyV2 is a unified onboard vision-language-action model that enables real-time aerial navigation and reasoning on resource-constrained hardware using shared multimodal representations.

items.title: AB-Attention: Accurate Block Attention for Accelerating Video Diffusion Transformers
items.description: AB-Attention approximates dense video diffusion attention with high sparsity via intra-block clustering, weighted sampling, and fine-grained kernel gathering, improving fidelity and speed.

items.title: Online Dense Reinforcement Learning with Planning-Grounding Agent for UI Navigation on Live IOS Apps
items.description: An online reinforcement learning framework trains UI navigation agents on live mobile apps using a planning agent, UI grounding model, and a novel neighbor-conditioned value estimation method to improve robustness and reduce inference costs.

items.title: Multi-Token Prediction Done Right
items.description: Soft-MTP removes a noisy gradient residual from multi-token prediction via a straight-through KL recovery trick, improving perplexity, speculative decoding, and reasoning without added cost.

items.title: Investor's Last Exam: Can AI Agents Do Equity Investment Without Seeing the Future?
items.description: Investor's Last Exam evaluates financial agents on end-to-end equity research using frozen evidence, expert criteria, and dependency graphs, revealing that top models excel at research but fail at forecasting and investment judgments.

items.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
items.description: A-RSI improves recursive self-improvement by refreshing training tasks based on declining learning signals and using independently verifiable program-generated answers, raising benchmark performance without external labels.

items.title: AtomicChat/LFM3-1.7B-Uncensored-GGUF
items.description: Text generation model from AtomicChat. 28.4k downloads and 135 likes so far.

items.title: Look Only When Needed: Certificate-Guided Visual Routing for Efficient Diffusion VLMs
items.description: LOWN adaptively skips image processing during diffusion vision-language model decoding when predictions agree, reducing computation while preserving accuracy.

items.title: Neuron Studio
items.description: Neuron Studio

items.title: OFat34764e/InterviewCopilot-rpocket-team
items.description: EdTech application designed to bridge the gap between learning and landing your dream job

items.title: Holo4D: Holistic 4D Reconstruction as Geometric Control for Video Diffusion
items.description: Holo4D guides video diffusion with reconstructed 3D trajectory scaffolds to synthesize novel-view videos while preserving geometry and motion.

items.title: Lasm – Write formally verified webapps in Lean for Node/serverless/edge
items.description: Lasm has been my dream for a good part of 2026. I firmly believe that formal verification is the next evolution of software engineering and programming languages.
items.ai_summary: Compiler that translates Lean 4 programs into WebAssembly to build formally verified web applications for Node, serverless, and edge runtimes.

items.title: I Turned DOOM into a Transformer
items.description: Instead of trying to run DOOM on things, I have instead decided to use DOOM (many, many, many doom games actually) to create a transformer.
items.ai_summary: A Python tool compiles integer neural networks into ZDoom maps to run them inside the ViZDoom game engine.

items.title: We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
items.description: Trending on Hacker News from labs.ycombinator.com. 239 points and 81 comments.

items.title: Elucidating the Design Space of LM Data Attribution
items.description: Data attribution methods for Language Models (LMs) are typically evaluated using downstream tasks like fact retrieval. However, existing evaluations vary multiple dataset properties simultaneously, making it impossible to isolate exactly why an attribution algorithm fails.
items.ai_summary: Controlled Attribution Benchmark framework that evaluates language model data attribution using synthetic fictitious knowledge and negative log-odds gradients.

items.title: Propose-Filter-Release: Scaling Noise to Typical Sensitivity via Private Filtering
items.description: An estimator can be accurate and stable on typical data, yet sensitive to a few possible records.
items.ai_summary: Propose-filter-release privacy primitive that turns mechanisms protecting typical records into differentially private mechanisms by privately filtering inputs.

items.title: Micro-Edits: Computational Support for Fine-Scale Edits in Film
items.description: In film editing, every frame matters. While macro, content-level edits shape the high-level narrative of a film, small local edits often control timing and direct visual attention.
items.ai_summary: AI-driven computational tools and mathematical formalization that help professional film editors efficiently execute fine-scale micro-edits.

items.title: Rethinking Neural Thickets Without Weight Perturbations
items.description: The Neural Thickets hypothesis posits that pretrained language models lie in dense neighborhoods of task-specific experts in weight space, which random Gaussian perturbations can uncover.
items.ai_summary: Method called Perturb-Select-Vote that utilizes output diversity, selection, and voting to match or exceed the performance of full-weight perturbations on various tasks.

items.title: Read, Allocate, Route: Role-Coupled Tokenization for Pixel-Space Generative Transformers
items.description: SpecSlot improves pixel-space generative Transformers by using localized spectral slots and restricted global attention to increase image detail without raising computational cost.
items.ai_summary: Pixel-space rectified-flow Transformer named SpecSlot that decouples output detail from global attention sequence length to improve generation efficiency and performance on ImageNet.

items.title: Adaptive Scenario Generation for KL-DRO Around a Learned Density Model
items.description: Distributionally robust optimization (DRO) hedges data-driven two-stage stochastic programs against error in the distribution estimated from a finite record, and standard ambiguity sets differ in how they treat realizations absent from that record.
items.ai_summary: Adaptive scenario generation method for distributionally robust optimization that centers the Kullback-Leibler ball at a learned density model to lower costs under distribution shift.

items.title: Luggage re-identification: A study of strategies towards a real-world application
items.description: Luggage re-identification (ReID) is a critical task in video surveillance for forensics, security or border management (suspicious or abandoned luggage recognition), as well as luggage management (lost luggage recovery).
items.ai_summary: End-to-end video pipeline strategy for luggage re-identification across multiple camera views to address real-world challenges like occlusions and crowded scenes.

items.title: From extreme weather to agricultural consequences with agentic AI
items.description: Extreme weather is forecast days ahead, yet its consequences for agriculture remain hard to predict: a forecast says where a storm will strike, not which crops will suffer or how much is at risk, and the records that could tell span many sources.
items.ai_summary: Agentic AI framework named WxCrop that combines weather indices and causal analysis with agricultural records to reliably predict crop loss from extreme weather.

items.title: SonoWorld4D: From One Video to a 4D Audio-Visual Scene via Diffusion Synchronization
items.description: Recent progress in visual scene generation has extended beyond static 3D scenes toward the more challenging problem of generating dynamic 4D scenes from minimal input.
items.ai_summary: Framework named SonoWorld4D that transforms a monocular video into an explorable 4D audio-visual scene by synchronizing visual motion and dual-space audio diffusion.

items.title: world2vec: Mechanistic world models through latent dynamics learning
items.description: World models can achieve strong control performance without faithfully capturing the dynamics of their environment, limiting their potential for mechanistic interpretability and scientific discovery.
items.ai_summary: Method named world2vec that learns mechanistic world models directly from observations and actions to achieve strong continuous control and accurate system identification.

items.title: Probing Spatial State Representations in Visual Foundation Models
items.description: Visual foundation models vary in supporting persistent spatial states across structure, persistence, prediction, and action, with readout accuracy not guaranteeing history-based updates or reliable goal-directed progress.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation framework that probes visual foundation models across four spatial capabilities using streaming egocentric observations of static indoor environments.

items.title: SymAnt: Grounding Long-Horizon Action Anticipation with Adaptable Symbolic Priors
items.description: As robots and intelligent systems increasingly interact with humans, they must anticipate long sequences of future actions from only brief observations.
items.ai_summary: Neuro-symbolic approach named SymAnt that combines neural networks with scene and knowledge graphs to anticipate long-horizon actions from short video observations.

items.title: ShallowDefend: Harnessing Shallow Safety Alignment for Multi-Turn Defender
items.description: Safety alignment has enabled large language models to reliably refuse harmful requests directly, yet the same request distributed across a multi-turn conversation still succeeds far too often.
items.ai_summary: Framework named Assess-to-Decide-to-Respond that uses shallow safety alignment and reinforcement learning to improve multi-turn safety defenses in large language models.

items.title: Testimony from Timelines: Evidence-Grounded Significance Testing of Temporal Clinical Hypotheses
items.description: Ask a language model whether sales tend to dip after a product recall, or whether one side effect tends to follow another after a vaccine, and it answers in a fluent sentence that reads like a finding, with no test behind it.
items.ai_summary: STRATA is a benchmark that evaluates decision-making steps in clinical temporal hypothesis testing, revealing that language models struggle primarily with evidence selection.

items.title: An ODE-based Sampler for Discrete Diffusion Models
items.description: The marginals of a continuous diffusion model can be reproduced by a deterministic ordinary differential equation (ODE), known as the probability flow ODE, which provides a foundation for accelerated sampling and consistency distillation.
items.ai_summary: Exponential residual flows provide an ODE-based sampler for discrete diffusion models that preserves marginals and supports consistency distillation for text and code generation.

items.title: Difficulty Calibration Across Time for Membership Inference in Diffusion Models
items.description: Modern diffusion models are trained on massive datasets that often include copyrighted or private images. Membership inference attacks (MIAs) address this by testing whether a given image was in a model's training set.
items.ai_summary: Reference-model calibration and temporal self-calibration isolate memorization from data difficulty across training and diffusion time to improve membership inference attacks.

items.title: L3G-World: Real-Time Infinite World Generation with Latent 3D Gaussian Memory
items.description: L3G-World uses a compact latent 3D Gaussian memory and alternating autoregressive updates with a video diffusion transformer to generate spatially consistent interactive worlds in real time.
items.ai_summary: L3G-World combines feed-forward reconstruction with a latent 3D Gaussian memory to achieve real-time, spatially consistent world generation with high efficiency.

items.title: TextSeal2: Distortion-Free LLM Watermarking with Copula Mixing and Memoryless Races
items.description: We present TextSeal2, a distortion-free watermark for large language models that keeps its signal under speculative decoding: tokens that replace rejected drafts remain watermarked with the same keys, and the acceptance rate is unchanged.
items.ai_summary: TextSeal2 is a distortion-free watermarking method for large language models that preserves signal strength and output diversity under speculative decoding.

items.title: When to Assist and What to Suggest: Joint Gating and Memory-Grounded Hint Generation in One Compact Decoder
items.description: Proactive assistants offer short, memory-grounded hints during a conversation, deciding when to assist and what to suggest. Current systems split this between a gate and a larger generator; we evaluate both together on 28,058 decision points.
items.ai_summary: A compact single-model decoder performs joint gating and memory-grounded hint generation, matching or exceeding multi-model pipelines with reduced wall-clock time.

items.title: Fight World Model: Customizable Combat through Visual Interaction Proxies
items.description: A playable, programmable game world must maintain persistent state, enforce executable rules, and support extensible gameplay mechanics. Existing video world models can generate plausible combat, yet struggle to keep hit reactions and health updates consistent with game rules.
items.ai_summary: Fight World Model separates rule-governed combat execution from video rendering to provide customizable and rule-consistent game world simulations.

items.title: HairDeck: Animation-Ready Stylized Hair Cards from a Single Image
items.description: HairDeck generates stylized hair cards and spring-bone animations as unordered token sets using a diffusion transformer, improving accuracy and speed over prior methods.

items.title: Collaborative AI agents for autonomous experimental research with solid-state quantum spins
items.description: An autonomous research laboratory could conduct an entire study, from formulating questions to preparing manuscripts. Artificial intelligence (AI) offers one route towards this goal.
items.ai_summary: Collaborative AI agents autonomously conduct solid-state quantum physics research by formulating questions, performing theoretical checks, and executing experiments.

items.title: Pre-Crime for Agents, at the Last Second: Probing When a Recruited Agent Gives In
items.description: When AI agents share channels and credentials, one agent can press another to break its operator's rule, a first step towards collusion. Output filters check only what an agent has already written. Can an overseer tell beforehand that an agent is about to give in?
items.ai_summary: Linear probes on agent activations detect when an AI agent is about to leak secrets during multi-agent peer pressure scenarios.

items.title: Beyond Ground Truth: A Heuristic Unsupervised Quality Assurance Engine for Diagnosing Calibrational Blindness in Dental Segmentation
items.description: In real-world clinical settings, dental X-ray segmentation using deep learning methods suffers from reliability issues. Even when the segmentation quality is bad, deep learning models show high confidence in their predictions (calibrational blindness).
items.ai_summary: HUS-QA is an unsupervised quality assurance engine that evaluates dental X-ray segmentation quality without requiring ground-truth masks.

items.title: Multistatic ISAC with Deep Learning-Based Clutter Suppression for 5G and Beyond
items.description: Integrated sensing and communications (ISAC) systems using 5G and beyond signals of opportunity enable joint wireless sensing and communication using shared infrastructure and spectrum resources.
items.ai_summary: Multistatic integrated sensing and communication framework that uses deep learning-based clutter suppression to improve target position and velocity estimation in 5G and beyond networks.

items.title: RADIOlogy: A Single-Pass Approach to Training-Free Zero-Shot Anomaly Detection
items.description: Current zero-shot anomaly detection methods often rely on complex prompt-learning techniques or computationally expensive sliding-window strategies to achieve fine-grained visual alignment to detect small-scale anomalies.
items.ai_summary: RADIOlogy is a training-free zero-shot anomaly detection technique that utilizes multi-head attention pooling in vision-language models for fine-grained visual anomaly localization and segmentation.

items.title: VeriCUA: Verification as Agentic Exploration for Computer-Using Agents
items.description: Building and scaling computer-using agents (CUAs) across desktop, mobile, and web environments requires reliable task-completion verification for data curation, evaluation, and reinforcement learning.
items.ai_summary: VeriCUA is a platform-agnostic verification framework for computer-using agents that performs dynamic evidence gathering and assessment through GUI or code checks.

items.title: Multi-View MoE: Letting Every Router Shape Expert Computation
items.description: Sparse mixture-of-experts (MoE) models expand parameter capacity by activating a small subset of experts per token. Expert selection directly affects model capabilities under a fixed active-expert budget.
items.ai_summary: Multi-View MoE is a sparse mixture-of-experts model that uses multiple routers to improve expert selection and reuse routing preferences to modulate expert computation.

items.title: PIVOT: Progressive Intervention via Online Teacher Correction
items.description: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards (RLVR) is limited by sparse outcome-level feedback on hard reasoning tasks: when all rollouts in a group fail, rewards provide no learning signal.
items.ai_summary: PIVOT is a reinforcement learning method that combines teacher-generated trajectory interventions with token-level KL supervision to improve performance on hard reasoning tasks.

items.title: Every Token Needs Its Own Teacher: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-distillation
items.description: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation selects a preferred teacher for each token during training, improving mathematical reasoning performance over fixed-teacher methods.
items.ai_summary: Multi-teacher Adaptive On-policy Self-Distillation is a token-level adaptive self-distillation method that allows every token in a response to select its preferred teacher during language model training.

items.title: Self-regularization and structural adaptation of NPMLE for Gaussian mixture models in all dimensions
items.description: We establish structural properties of the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator (NPMLE) for $d$-dimensional Gaussian mixtures whose means lie in a hypercube.
items.ai_summary: Study establishes that the nonparametric maximum likelihood estimator for multivariate Gaussian mixture models automatically self-regularizes to optimal model complexity without explicit model selection.

items.title: Gym-Anything for Robotics: Scaling physical simulations with digital agents
items.description: Realistic, fast robotics simulations could enable large-scale training of embodied AI models that transfer to the real world. However, despite decades of progress, available simulations cover only a narrow range of real-world tasks and physical phenomena.
items.ai_summary: Gym-Anything for Robotics is a framework that uses coding agents within an adversarial creation-audit loop to automatically generate realistic robotics simulations and reinforcement learning environments.

items.title: Training Foundation Models with a Single Algorithm
items.description: Foundation-model training stages can be unified under a single likelihood-based algorithm that blends static data and reinforcement learning generations, improving efficiency and capability retention.
items.ai_summary: Unified training is a likelihood-based training algorithm that integrates pretraining, fine-tuning, and reinforcement learning stages into a single framework for foundation models.

items.title: Comparing Human Role-Players and LLM-Simulated Clients in Online Counselling Training: An Analysis of Counselling Patterns
items.description: This study investigates the capabilities of Large Language Models to simulate counselling clients in educational role-plays in comparison to human role-players.
items.ai_summary: Study analyzes counselling communication patterns to demonstrate the effectiveness of large language models in simulating clients for educational role-playing exercises in counselor training.

items.title: FARMS: A Verifiable Foundation for Automated Computational Science
items.description: Automated computational science could accelerate discovery by selecting, adapting and developing numerical methods. This prospect requires mathematical knowledge that AI systems can interpret and reuse with explicit guarantees.
items.ai_summary: FARMS is a foundation framework that transforms computational mathematics into verified, AI-ready knowledge to support automated computational science.

items.title: Advancing Clinical Genomic Analysis with a Skill-Centred Agent
items.description: Clinical genomic analysis requires experts to integrate evolving guidelines, databases, and computational evidence.
items.ai_summary: ClinGeX is a large-language-model agent that composes curated executable skills to improve clinical genomic analysis and decision-making.

items.title: Ramanujan Challenge Results: AI-Assisted Evaluation Pipeline for Multi-Format Proofs
items.description: As AI's mathematical capabilities rapidly improve, meaningful benchmarks are shifting from university-level problems and math olympiads to research-level mathematics.
items.ai_summary: An AI-assisted evaluation pipeline for natural language proofs, code, and formalizations reduces false-positive verdicts and improves research-level math evaluation at scale.

items.title: Retrieval as Traversal: Value-Indexed Memory for Stateful Long-Context Agents
items.description: Long-context models repeatedly solve closely related retrieval problems. Attention or global retrieval can retain large stores, but each forward pass again searches for what matters. Recurrent compression avoids this search only by deciding earlier what information to preserve.
items.ai_summary: Retrieval as Traversal is a persistent local memory indexing method that improves stateful long-context agent performance while regulating retrieval costs.

items.title: Machine Learning-Based Detection of Mobile Money Scan Messages in Ghana: A Comparative Evaluation of Naive Bayes, Support Vector Machine, and Randon Forest Classifiers
items.description: Mobile money (MoMo) is Ghana's preferred retail payment channel, recording GHC518.4 billion in transactions in December 2025 and over 26.7 million active accounts (Graphic Online, 2026).
items.ai_summary: A supervised machine-learning pipeline using Naive Bayes and support vector machines accurately classifies scam and legitimate mobile money SMS messages in Ghana.

items.title: On the Fundamental Limits of Prefill-Based Decoding Length Prediction
items.description: Predicting how many tokens a large language model (LLM) will decode, using only prefill-phase hidden states, is a key primitive for inference scheduling.
items.ai_summary: An analysis of prefill-based decoding length prediction reveals fundamental stochastic limits and bounds for estimating large language model responses.

items.title: TRACER, a time-to-event EHR foundation model for disease detection across health systems
items.description: Foundation models trained on longitudinal electronic health records (EHRs) can predict clinical diagnoses years in the future, making them a potential tool for disease screening.
items.ai_summary: TRACER is a decoder-based electronic health record foundation model pretrained to predict future disease diagnoses for clinical screening across health systems.

items.title: Efficient Scalable Oversight via Rewinding
items.description: Scalable oversight asks how a weak verifier can check the outputs of computations performed by more powerful AI systems.
items.ai_summary: Rewindable interactive proofs are a new verification model that enables efficient scalable AI oversight by allowing verifiers to restore prover states.

items.title: Homebrewed SLMs: Autoregressive and Masked Diffusion Language Models Built at Home for Portuguese
items.description: Building a language model of one's own no longer requires a data centre. This tutorial trains one from scratch, tokenizer included, on one consumer GPU, and shows how to tell whether it is good for the tasks of a specialist domain. It proposes no new method.
items.ai_summary: A practical tutorial demonstrates how to train small autoregressive and masked diffusion language models for Brazilian Portuguese on a single consumer GPU.

items.title: BURGER: Benchmarking and Understanding Robotic Generalization via Embodied Drawing
items.description: How effectively can vision-language-action (VLA) models learn diverse language-conditioned behaviors as training data scales? Investigating this question requires large and varied robot datasets, whose collection on physical robots remains costly.
items.ai_summary: BURGER is a robotic drawing benchmark with a prompt-driven generation pipeline used to evaluate vision-language-action models on language-conditioned tasks.

items.title: PhysCount: Do MLLMs Count Visual Appearances or Physical Entities?
items.description: Images reveal appearances, but counting often asks about physical objects. A single entity may be visible directly, in several reflections, or through glass, so detecting every visible occurrence does not determine how many entities are present.
items.ai_summary: PhysCount is a benchmark for evaluating whether multimodal large language models can distinguish between visible object appearances and physical entities in a scene.

items.title: NEOPIC: A Neural Operator Framework for Particle-based Kinetic Plasma Simulations
items.description: We introduce NEOPIC, a framework for learning the field operator in particle-based methods applied to kinetic plasma simulations.
items.ai_summary: NEOPIC is a neural operator framework that acts directly on particle distributions as a plug-and-play field solver for kinetic plasma simulations.

items.title: CrossWeave: Cross-Modal Scene and Instance Retrieval from Sparse 2D-3D Alignment
items.description: Cross-modal scene and instance retrieval aims to retrieve a corresponding 3D environment or object given query 2D images, serving as a foundational mechanism for spatial reasoning in robotics and AR/VR.
items.ai_summary: CrossWeave is a cross-modal retrieval framework that uses sparse patch-point alignment supervision to perform both scene- and instance-level retrieval with a single model.

items.title: IndicIPR-QA: A Benchmark for Extractive Question Answering on Indian IPR Laws
items.description: Legal Question Answering (QA) over statutory texts is a challenging task in Natural Language Processing (NLP), especially in low-resource settings with complex legal systems. It requires answers that are precise and grounded in the law.
items.ai_summary: IndicIPR-QA is an extractive question-answering benchmark containing 4,462 QA pairs across seven Indian Intellectual Property Rights Acts.

items.title: How I Aligned Your Model: Scaling Up Multilingual Safety Training with Templates
items.description: Researchers developed a scalable template-based pipeline to generate multilingual safety datasets, revealing that English-only evaluations misjudge multilingual model safety and that culturally localized training improves alignment across languages.
items.ai_summary: MSafeTemp is a validated multilingual safety corpus spanning 60 languages, produced using a scalable template-based augmentation pipeline for safety training and evaluation.

items.title: Claude Duet is the first personal-assistant-type harness that feels useful
items.description: Trending on Hacker News from fig.blue. 114 points and 113 comments.

items.title: A Low-Rank Space Captures Linear Alignment Between LLM and Human Neural Activity During Naturalistic Language Listening
items.description: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used as computational models of human language processing, yet it remains unclear which components of their representations drive alignment with neural activity.
items.ai_summary: A low-rank regression method identifies a compact 1-3% subspace of large language model representations that linearly predicts human neural activity during language listening.

items.title: Discovering Interpretable Acoustic Features in Autoregressive Voice-Cloning TTS Models
items.description: Voice-cloning TTS models synthesize an unseen speaker's voice from brief speech prompts, but it remains unclear which acoustic properties they represent and use.
items.ai_summary: A feature-based interpretability framework analyzes sparse autoencoders and principal components to uncover acoustic features and concepts in autoregressive voice-cloning text-to-speech models.

items.title: Algebraic World Model: From Exploration to Proofs
items.description: AI has made remarkable progress in mathematics, solving challenging problems with machine-checkable proofs in Lean, yet typically relying on predefined mathematical definitions and formal specifications.
items.ai_summary: The Algebraic World Model is a framework that explores unfamiliar environments, builds executable Python hypotheses, and formalizes them in Lean 4 to prove reachability and impossibility.

items.title: Numerical Integration on Bounded Domains via Learned Reflected Diffusions
items.description: We study high-dimensional integration on bounded convex domains. Given a non-negative integrand $r$, the goal is to estimate $Z=\int_{D}r(x)\,\mathrm dx$ on $D\subset\mathbb R^d$.
items.ai_summary: A reflected diffusion sampling method uses learned neural score models and importance sampling to perform high-dimensional numerical integration on bounded convex domains.

items.title: LucidLyra: Feed-Forward Generative 3D Scene Reconstruction and Joint Understanding via Multi-Task Distillation
items.description: We present LucidLyra, a framework that makes generatively reconstructed 3D scenes directly queryable for semantics and instances in a feed-forward manner from video latents.
items.ai_summary: LucidLyra is a generative 3D scene reconstruction framework that distills knowledge from video diffusion and 2D vision models to jointly infer geometry, semantics, and instance cues.

items.title: AI in the EGI e-infrastructure -- Past experiences and future strategies
items.description: The EGI Federation has provided federated e-infrastructure services to European and global science for over 15 years.
items.ai_summary: Review of the EGI Federation's history with AI in European science projects and presentation of its 2026-2030 strategy focused on AI-ready infrastructure, skills, and trust.

items.title: Agentic University: Collaborative Agents for Personalized Learning
items.description: Large language models support personalized tutoring, content generation, and adaptive learning paths. However, capability development requires these resources and interactions to form a coherent learning process that evolves with the learner.
items.ai_summary: Human-Participatory Multi-Agent Organization and Agentic University framework that aligns personal goals, learning activities, and assessments to support personalized student learning paths.

items.title: Fast and accurate neural triage decoding of ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes
items.description: Quantum error correction is essential for fault-tolerant quantum computing.
items.ai_summary: Neural triage decoding framework that uses syndrome consistency to allocate neural computation, achieving state-of-the-art accuracy while reducing decoding latency for ultra-high-rate quantum LDPC codes.

items.title: rTaste: Do Research Agents Have Taste? Evaluating Early Stage Research Judgment
items.description: Frontier AI research agents propose many sound experiments but show limited ability to rank them better than simple baselines, with teams offering no clear quality gains.
items.ai_summary: Evaluation of frontier model research agents proposing and ranking minimum viable experiments to test their early-stage research judgment and taste.

items.title: MetaRefine: Score Refinement with Multi-Level Features for Image Assessment
items.description: An image's original dimensions, aspect ratio, and composition provide important cues that can affect its technical and aesthetic quality. Image assessment methods use resizing, cropping, padding, or patch sampling to accommodate different input sizes.
items.ai_summary: MetaRefine is a metadata-aware score refinement architecture that uses geometry, multi-level visual features, and original scores to improve the accuracy of image assessment models.

items.title: The Precision Wall: An Optimizer-Dependent Boundary for Optimization under Power-Law Measurement Spectra
items.description: In low-rank matrix sensing of a rank-$D$ factor $U^\ast \in \mathbb{R}^{V \times D}$, replacing isotropic Gaussian designs with power-law measurement covariance $Σ= \mathrm{diag}(j^{-s})_{j=1}^V$ leaves the Burer--Monteiro landscape free of spurious local minima, yet…
items.ai_summary: Analysis of an optimizer-dependent precision wall that causes division-normalized first-order optimizers to stall above a critical exponent in power-law measurement spectra.

items.title: Preserving Utility in Continual LLM Unlearning via Orthogonal Projections
items.description: Unlearning concerns the task of removing the influence of a sensitive portion of the training data, such as protected, copyrighted or private text, from a model without retraining it from scratch.
items.ai_summary: Continual Orthogonal Projection is a gradient-projection scheme that preserves model utility and prevents performance decay during iterated, sequential LLM unlearning requests.

items.title: FIRME: Registry-Anchored Memory Graphs for Evolving, Heterogeneous Investor Knowledge
items.description: Financial AI workflows that reuse investor knowledge need persistent memory that integrates observations across sources and periods without losing identity or provenance.
items.ai_summary: Fusion and Identity Registry for Memory Evolution is a registry-anchored memory graph that reconciles incoming observations to persistent canonical relationships for investor knowledge workflows.

items.title: AVPS-360: A Spatial Audio-Visual Benchmark for Instance Segmentation and Tracking of Sound-Producing Persons
items.description: Audio-visual instance segmentation (AVIS) segments and tracks individual sound-producing objects in videos. Existing benchmarks predominantly use monaural audio, which lacks inter-channel cues for spatially distinguishing concurrent sound sources.
items.ai_summary: AVPS-360 is a spatial audio-visual benchmark combining first-order Ambisonics audio with 360-degree video to improve the instance segmentation and tracking of sound-producing persons.

items.title: Accurate MRI-free PET Quantification and Reliability Assessment via CT-to-MRI Synthesis and Conformal Prediction
items.description: Standardized uptake value ratio (SUVR) quantification of amyloid PET commonly relies on a subject-specific T1-weighted MRI, yet a usable MRI is not always available.
items.ai_summary: MRI-free PET quantification method combining CT-to-MRI synthesis and conformal prediction to accurately estimate amyloid PET standardized uptake value ratios and assess result reliability without real MRIs.

items.title: Training language models in simulation for psychiatric intake
items.description: In psychiatric practice, the clinical intake interview remains a primary diagnostic instrument, requiring the clinician to establish rapport while disentangling complex, overlapping presentations.
items.ai_summary: Multi-turn reinforcement learning in simulation environments improves language model performance on structured text-based psychiatric intake interviews, including history-taking and diagnosis.

items.title: Pika-Labs/Pika-H3-Flex
items.description: Image-to-video model from Pika-Labs. 0 downloads and 126 likes so far.

items.title: Rural Readiness: Domain Generalization with Adversarially Chosen Domains
items.description: Predictive models trained at well-resourced data-rich institutions often fail when deployed in new populations.
items.ai_summary: Theoretical analysis shows that domain generalization sample complexity reduces significantly from exponential to linear terms under a relaxed learning goal, improving performance for data-scarce populations.

items.title: InfantNet: A Large Scale Dataset for Infant Body Pose and Shape Estimation
items.description: Infant pose and shape estimation is essential for applications in childcare, developmental monitoring, and medical diagnosis.
items.ai_summary: InfantNet provides a large-scale real-image dataset and benchmark with 2D and 3D annotations to improve infant pose and shape estimation models.

items.title: A Unified Benchmark for Aerial-Enhanced Autonomous Driving: The KITScenes Aerial Dataset
items.description: Aerial imagery provides complementary spatial context for autonomous driving by exposing road structure beyond the immediate perception range of onboard sensors.
items.ai_summary: KITScenes Aerial extends a multimodal autonomous driving dataset with spatially associated aerial imagery to improve fine-grained mapping and cross-view localization.

items.title: Glance: The Generator Is Its Own Reranker

items.ai_summary: Glance equips a language model generator with a lightweight adapter to score and rerank retrieval candidate passages from a shared prefill without separate reranker models.

items.title: PhysInsert: Physically Plausible Object Insertion with Geometric Priors and Bidirectional Object-Scene Interactions
items.description: PhysInsert enables physically plausible object insertion by jointly adapting objects and scenes using geometry-guided adaptation and spatial supervision on aligned counterfactual data.
items.ai_summary: PhysInsert is a framework for physically plausible object insertion that jointly adapts object pose, illumination, and scene geometry using a newly constructed benchmark dataset.

items.title: Reinforcement learning for control of partial differential equations

items.ai_summary: A comprehensive review examines reinforcement learning approaches for controlling dynamical systems governed by partial differential equations, highlighting sample efficiency and scalability.

items.title: Learning developmental dynamics from lineage context
items.description: A central goal of biology is to predict the dynamics of multicellular systems. Lineage context (the states of a cell's sisters, cousins, etc.) could inform these predictions, but how best to leverage it remains unclear.
items.ai_summary: Lineage inpainting is a generative modeling approach using tree-structured transformers and lineage context to predict cell state dynamics and simulate perturbation responses in multicellular systems.

items.title: Prefix Executability: Evaluating Tool-Using Agents Beyond Final Success
items.description: Tool-use benchmarks often score agents by final task success, but terminal outcomes can obscure whether the intermediate tool-call trajectory was executable. We propose prefix executability as a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents.
items.ai_summary: Prefix executability is a trajectory-level evaluation protocol for tool-using agents that measures whether every prefix of a predicted tool-call sequence remains executable.

items.title: Framework-Conditional Open Materials Generation
items.description: Theoretical predictions of novel materials rely on a variety of techniques, from data-mining-based ion substitution methods to fully de novo generative models.
items.ai_summary: OMatG-FC is a framework-conditional generative method that predicts inorganic crystalline materials by fixing structural frameworks while using discrete flow matching on atomic species.

items.title: A Pretrained Model for Bayesian Filtering in Heterogeneous Dynamical Systems
items.description: Filtering has not yet had its foundation-model moment: state estimation is still dominated either by online Bayesian filtering algorithms that require known dy- namics as inputs, or by learning-based neural filters trained from scratch for a single system or parametric family.
items.ai_summary: FilterFM is a pretrained model for Bayesian filtering that estimates latent states across heterogeneous dynamical systems using a single checkpoint.

items.title: Soil Moisture Estimation in Precision Agriculture: A Knowledge Distillation Approach
items.description: Accurate soil moisture estimation is critical for precision agriculture, influencing irrigation, fertilization, and harvesting strategies.
items.ai_summary: Soil Moisture Distillation is a knowledge distillation framework that leverages unimodal teachers to enhance multimodal soil moisture estimation in precision agriculture.

items.title: Adaptive search with path-constrained mobile sensors using multi-arm bandits
items.description: We study a constrained sequential decision problem for detecting regions of interest from noisy online measurements collected by a team of energy-constrained mobile sensors.

items.title: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis: integrating reinforcement learning and conformal prediction for reliable wafer defect classification
items.description: Semiconductor manufacturing is a complex, multi-step process that requires both high precision and low operating costs. Therefore, detecting defects in a high-volume setting is an important component of wafer map analysis for reliable production.
items.ai_summary: Uncertainty-aware Feedback Loop Diagnosis integrates reinforcement learning and conformal prediction to classify wafer defects while reducing measurement acquisition time.

items.title: NECA: Neighbor Event Curve Augmentation for Multi-Horizon ICU Deterioration Prediction
items.description: Early prediction of ICU organ dysfunction events supports timely clinical monitoring and intervention, but estimating short-term organ-specific risk from early ICU records remains challenging due to irregular measurements, heterogeneous clinical variables, and the need to…
items.ai_summary: Neighbor Event-Curve Augmentation is a model-agnostic method that uses similar historical patient event timing to improve multi-horizon ICU deterioration prediction.

items.title: IMPACT: Inverter-Informed Multimodal Learning for Photovoltaic Generation Forecasting

items.ai_summary: Inverter-informed multimodal learning framework combines temporal history and spatial cloud dynamics for probabilistic photovoltaic power forecasting.

items.title: OCCAMS: A Multi-Task Learning-Based Investigation of the CMB Power Spectra
items.description: How many latent variables are needed to fit the cosmic microwave background (CMB) temperature and polarisation power spectra when a neural network is given no cosmological model, and to what extent do they map onto the standard cosmological parameters?
items.ai_summary: Multi-task learning variational autoencoders determine the latent variables needed to fit cosmic microwave background power spectra without a built-in cosmological model.

items.title: Bridging Neural Representations and Symbolic Semantics in Audio Classification
items.description: Deep audio classifiers can achieve strong predictive performance, but their hidden representations remain difficult to interpret.

items.title: Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation

items.title: SCARL: Sequence Confidence-Aligned Reinforcement Learning

items.title: Continuous-Action World Models: Learning Cross-Embodiment Spatiotemporal Dynamics Priors
